concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-risk-management-chargeback-guidelines-mexicodomestic-chargebacks]] — Adyen Mexico domestic chargeback guide (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) for optional RFI, NoC-based defense, second chargeback, and optional arbitration pursuit.
warnings: The pinned page names Mexico domestic but does not mention Carnet; do not infer universal Carnet scope.

The 25-day defense clock starts on NoC receipt; the issuer's 30-day second-chargeback window starts from first-chargeback defense; the merchant's 10-day arbitration-contact window starts on second-chargeback receipt. The USD 500 fine requires arbitration raised and lost.
